stem: Which message does the poet express in the poem “Out Where the West Begins”?

options.label: A
options.text: The people in the West break the rules.

options.label: B
options.text: The weather in the West can change quickly.

options.label: C
options.text: The West is not only a place but also a way of life.

options.label: D
options.text: The West is a large place but easy to find.
